blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.description: Blackwell 2-GPU CFG-parallel + cuDNN-SDPA SGLang-Diffusion Cosmos3 T2I profile.
blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --attention-backend torch_cudnn_sdpa --tp-size 1 --cfg-parallel-size 2 --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed --enable-torch-compile false
blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.notes: Measured on 4xB200 2026-09-13, two interleaved rounds. Against the previous `--tp-size 2 --attention-backend fa` command: 0.765 -> 0.576s and 0.797 -> 0.575s, about -25%, taking the cell from losing to vLLM-Omni (0.651-0.662s) to beating it. TWO changes, both measured separately. (1) CFG parallelism instead of TP: the case is guidance_scale 6.0 -- true CFG, two branches -- so one branch per GPU with the DiT replicated and one combine per step beats splitting every layer and paying an all-reduce per layer (0.765 -> 0.584, 0.797 -> 0.617). It is also what sglang's own runtime would choose: cosmos3 inherits auto_enable_cfg_parallel=True with get_auto_cfg_parallel_degree(2)->2 and _model_default_uses_cfg()->True, but `--tp-size 2` made _has_explicit_parallel_policy() true and suppressed it. The sibling Cosmos3 T2V profile already uses CFG parallel; T2I was the odd one out. (2) torch_cudnn_sdpa instead of fa, on top of that: 0.584 -> 0.576 and 0.617 -> 0.575, same sign both rounds, and far steadier -- its repeats spread 0.9% (0.572-0.577) where fa's swung 0.579-0.792. Exact softmax, same precision class as fa, and the backend vLLM-Omni serves this case with. fa2 does not run at all: there is no native transformer for it, so the loader tries a Diffusers fallback and refuses under tp>1. NOTE: at tp_size=1 that refusal no longer guards this cell -- the harness scans the server log for the fallback markers instead.

blackwell-cudnn-static.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for cosmos3_nano_t2i_720p using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn-static.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box. Also drops --stage-configs-path: vLLM-Omni 0.29 rejects it outright (`stage_configs_path is no longer supported; use deploy_config instead`), and upstream's own cosmos3 deploy file says the T2I/video checkpoints must keep the default single-stage diffusion fallback -- so cfg-parallel and guardrails move to the first-class flags rather than to a new YAML. The old YAML also pinned enforce_eager, which silently ran this competitor compile-off against the policy. 2026-10-22: --no-diffusion-compile-dynamic added; cand-dynamic keeps the previous command for the A/B. VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 4xB300).

default.description: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen, NVIDIA's official cosmos3-t2i-1gpu.yaml at BF16, 2 GPU(s).
default.notes: Official T2I config with the CFG pair split over two GPUs. T2I applies CFG only for t in [400, 1000], as sglang (COSMOS3_T2I_GUIDANCE_INTERVAL) and vLLM-Omni do by default. The earlier 'failed' verdict (startup hang on cosmos3_omni, tensorrt-llm 1.3.0rc26) is retested: --visual_gen_args forces the VisualGen path. VANILLA attention is torch SDPA (FlashAttention on Hopper); no cache_config or quant_config, so the row is BF16 and cache-free; compile at the case shape so the first request does not recompile; JSON to /v1/videos/sync (or /v1/images/generations), whose reply is the media itself. The YAML is passed with --visual_gen_args (trtllm-serve has no --extra_visual_gen_options). VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 2xH200/4xH200).

_previous_failed_entry.reason: Hangs at startup on the current Cosmos3-Nano checkpoint: trtllm-serve reaches 'Orchestrator is creating IPC executor' / 'using MpiPoolSession to spawn MPI processes' and then produces no output at all -- 40 min in the matrix, and 20 min each at tp=1 and tp=2 in a dedicated probe, so it is not a multi-GPU path issue. The startup log warns 'You are using a model of type cosmos3_omni to instantiate a model of type cosmos3': the checkpoint was re-uploaded 2026-08-26 and declares cosmos3_omni, which tensorrt-llm 1.3.0rc26 does not know. Marked failed rather than left supported so a run does not spend 40 minutes per attempt reaching the same hang. Re-test when trtllm adds cosmos3_omni; the profile is kept below.

trtllm-visual.extra_env_reason: The harness exports PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True. Under it, the CUDA IPC handle TRT-LLM's rank 0 hands its media over with needs pidfd_getfd in the server process, which RunPod containers deny: every request logged 'pidfd_getfd: Operation not permitted' and hung to the read timeout (4xB300, 2026-10-22). Plain segments use cudaIpcMemHandle instead.
